_note: DEMO CATALOG. Product families come from the owner’s photos and Facebook posts. Every price, size, wood name and rule here is a placeholder for the owner to confirm. None is an approved offer.

products.name: End-Grain Cutting Board
products.summary: Hundreds of blocks glued up so the knife meets the end of the grain.
products.description: End-grain boards are cut, turned on end and glued up a second time, so the pattern runs all the way through the board. Choose the size and pattern, then the details.

choices.label: Brass feet
choices.detail: lifts the board off the counter

rules.reason: A small board is too narrow for a juice groove. Choose Medium or Large to add one.

upsells.label: Engraved initials or date
upsells.note: One line, on the side or the back

details.Dimensions: Sizes are approximate, and thickness runs about 1.5 in. Exact dimensions are confirmed before the board is cut.
details.Woods & finish: Pattern woods vary with what is on the rack. Species names will be listed once the owner confirms them.
details.Production & delivery: Each board is made to order. Lead time, pickup and shipping are being finalised.
details.Product care: Hand wash and dry standing up. Never use the dishwasher and never soak it. Re-oil when the surface looks dry.

products.name: Striped Cutting Board
products.summary: Long strips of contrasting wood, edge-glued into one board.
products.description: Lighter than end grain and easy to live with, a striped board is the everyday board. Pick a size and a stripe.

details.Dimensions: Sizes are approximate, and thickness runs about 1 in.
details.Woods & finish: Species names will be listed once the owner confirms them.
details.Production & delivery: Made to order. Lead time and shipping are being finalised.
details.Product care: Hand wash and dry standing up. Re-oil when the surface looks dry.

products.name: Holiday Serving Tray
products.summary: Thanksgiving, fall and Christmas shapes for the holiday table.
products.description: Cut to a seasonal shape, then either carved into a sectioned party tray or left flat as a serving board.

details.Dimensions: About 16 in across. Exact size is confirmed with the order.
details.Woods & finish: Cherry, or walnut with cherry. These are named in the owner’s recent posts and still to be confirmed for the catalogue.
details.Production & delivery: Holiday cut-off dates will be posted here.
details.Product care: Hand wash only. Wipe it dry, then re-oil once the surface looks pale.

products.name: Coaster Set with Holder
products.summary: Striped or solid coasters that live in their own holder.
products.description: A set of coasters cut from the same boards, with a matching holder so they stay together on the table.

rules.reason: Octagon coasters are cut from one solid board, so they come in walnut only.

details.Dimensions: Each coaster is about 4 in across.
details.Woods & finish: Species names will be listed once the owner confirms them.
details.Production & delivery: Made to order. Lead time and shipping are being finalised.

products.name: Challenge Coin Display
products.summary: Shelved display for a coin collection, with an engraved crest.
products.description: An arched walnut display with shelves sized for challenge coins. The crest on top can be engraved from your unit’s artwork.

details.Dimensions: Overall size depends on the number of shelves. Exact dimensions are confirmed before cutting.
details.Woods & finish: Species names will be listed once the owner confirms them.
details.Production & delivery: Made to order. The crest artwork is approved before engraving.

products.name: Inlaid Monogram Sign
products.summary: A light-wood letter inlaid in a dark panel.
products.description: One letter, inlaid so it sits flush in a dark panel with a light border. Good for a front porch, a mantel or a wedding gift.

details.Woods & finish: Species names will be listed once the owner confirms them.
details.Product care: Indoor or covered porch. Dust with a dry cloth.

products.name: Built-ins & Cabinetry
products.summary: Shelving, cabinets and entertainment walls built to fit the room.
products.description: Built-ins are measured and designed around your room, so they start with a free conversation rather than a price tag.

details.How it works: Book a free call. If it’s a fit, you get a written quote. Work is scheduled once the quote is accepted and the deposit is paid.

products.name: Dining Tables & Furniture
products.summary: Tables, vanities, islands and the larger pieces meant to stay in a family.
products.description: Larger furniture is designed with you. Tell us the room, the size and the woods you like, and we’ll start from there.
products.photoNote: Photos of larger commissions are coming soon.

details.How it works: Book a free call. If it’s a fit, you get a written quote. Work is scheduled once the quote is accepted and the deposit is paid.

products.name: Custom Dog Gates
products.summary: Barn-door gates sized to your doorway.
products.description: Every doorway is different, so gates are measured first. Book a call and we’ll work out the size, the swing and the finish.

details.How it works: Book a free call and send a photo of the opening. You get a written quote after that.

products.name: Desks & Wall Units
products.summary: Fold-down desks and wall units built for a specific kid, room or corner.
products.description: A wall-mounted desk folds flat with a chalkboard face and opens into a work surface with shelves. Pieces like this are built to order.

details.How it works: Book a free call. If it’s a fit, you get a written quote.
